visualCharacteristics.purpose: photo gallery: sticky full-viewport scroll-driven collage on tablet/desktop (photos scatter out of a stack as you scroll), horizontal swipe slider on mobile, every photo opens in a keyboard-accessible lightbox

contentPattern.structure: one row per photo; the single cell holds an image (alt text required) linked to its full-size file, either as a link wrapping the image or a link placed next to it. Without a link the image itself opens in the lightbox

reuseGuidance: Use for an image-only photo gallery (around 6-12 photos) where each photo should open full size. Collage layout positions the first 12 photos in fixed slots and cycles them beyond 12. With prefers-reduced-motion the tablet/desktop layout becomes a static grid. For photos with titles or text use a cards variant instead.
